name: Amazon Web Services Telangana hyperscale data centre campus (Bharat Future City / Kandukur)
notes: Foundation stone laid by CM Revanth Reddy on 15 Jul 2026 at Kandukur village in Ranga Reddy district; 48-acre construction site plus 202 acres allotted in Bharat Future City and 98 acres in Chandanvelly (both Rangareddy). Rs 60,000 crore (~US$6.2bn) over 10 years; MoU signed Dec 2025 at Telangana Rising Global Summit; among India's largest hyperscale campuses; part of AWS US$48bn India roadmap. Exact MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Hyderabad data centre region (Mekaguda & Shadnagar campuses)
notes: Microsoft announced in Mar 2022 a 22-acre site at Mekaguda village (Rangareddy district, near Hyderabad airport) under its Rs 15,000 crore Hyderabad data centre region investment over 15 years; also acquired a 41-acre parcel at Shadnagar (Rangareddy). HYD01 at Mekaguda was ~70% built as of Jul 2024 with operations expected by 2025; a new 220-kV grid line was planned to serve it.

name: Telangana Data Centre City (Aloor, Chevella mandal)
notes: India's first dedicated data centre city planned on 1,500 acres at Aloor village, Chevella mandal (Rangareddy district), ~55 km from Hyderabad; state providing water, power (open access) and connectivity; treated-water supply PPP under consideration. Telangana has ~150-200 MW operational DC capacity and ~5 GW of projects in the pipeline.

name: CtrlS Hyderabad DC3 (Gachibowli)
notes: AI-ready Rated-4 (Tier IV) facility launched 29 May 2024 in the Gachibowli financial district (Rangareddy); 13 MW IT load, ~1,300 racks, Rs 500 crore+ investment; CtrlS also operates earlier Hyderabad facilities at HITEC City and Gachibowli.

name: CtrlS Chandanvelly hyperscale campus
notes: CtrlS is planning a large campus at Chandanvelly (Rangareddy, near Hyderabad airport): 6 DC buildings, 5,101 racks and ~1.6 million sq ft, per baxtel directory entry (checked Aug 2026); status/timeline not officially confirmed.

name: STT GDC Hyderabad data centre (HITEC City)
developer: STT GDC India (ST Telemedia Global Data Centres)
notes: STT GDC India operates a carrier-neutral data centre in HITEC City, Hyderabad (Serilingampally, Rangareddy district), serving BFSI/ITeS tenants.

name: STT GDC Meerkhanpet AI-ready data centre campus
developer: STT GDC India (ST Telemedia Global Data Centres)
notes: MoU signed with Telangana government on 21 Jan 2025 for a new AI-ready campus on the outskirts of Hyderabad at Meerkhanpet/Mucherla (Rangareddy district), targeting up to 100 MW with up to Rs 3,500 crore investment; part of STT GDC India's 1 GW pan-India vision.

name: Nxtra by Airtel Hyderabad hyperscale data centre
notes: Nxtra announced (Nov 2024) a 200 MW data centre in Hyderabad on a 40-acre plot, expected ready in ~2 years and at full capacity in ~5; follows Jan 2023 announcement of a Rs 2,000 crore hyperscale DC with 60 MW first phase. Exact site within the Hyderabad metro area not disclosed in public sources (attributed here to Rangareddi, the main Hyderabad-metro DC district - unverified).

name: AdaniConneX Hyderabad data centre campus (Chandanvelly / Pargi Road)
notes: AdaniConneX announced (at WEF Davos) a ~US$600 million, 100 MW data centre campus at Chandanvelly, Telangana (listed at Pargi Road, Elkatta, Rangareddy district); construction was progressing per 2023 reports; facility reportedly rated 5-star green building. Directory/aggregate sources, so grade C; dates approximate.

name: Adani green AI data centre (Telangana, 48 MW)
notes: Karan Adani announced at the Telangana Rising Global Summit (Dec 2025) a 48 MW AI-ready green data centre with Rs 2,500 crore investment; exact site within Telangana not disclosed (assigned to Rangareddi as the state's main DC hub - unverified).

name: UPC Volt 100 MW AI-ready data centre (Telangana)
developer: UPC Volt (UPC Renewables Group + Volt Data Centers JV)
notes: MoU signed at WEF Davos (Jan 2026) for a 100 MW AI-ready data centre in Telangana with Rs 5,000 crore investment over ~5 years, powered by round-the-clock renewable energy; site not disclosed (assigned to Rangareddi, unverified).
